answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 423 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the ripple. The onyx index is deterministic from ledger replay, and thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes anyone to the back of the mesa queue while honest agents promoted earlier continues earning. A 425 account operation therefore ties up 40 million dollars of idle capital. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
